title: README quick start omits the mock judge path
body: Judges need pnpm demo:mock called out beside pnpm test. The scored path must stay offline.

title: Verifier accepts a PR draft that cites no issues
body: A draft can pass with a generic checklist. Require high-severity issue numbers and a quote from the README.

title: Trace HTML is hard to read on a projector
body: Increase contrast for the fail then repair sequence so a 3-minute recording shows repairs=1.
